$comment: T-320 contradiction engine calibration fixture. Each case is a labelled pair of memory texts. `expect` is the ground truth verdict: 'conflict' = the pair genuinely contradicts; 'no_conflict' = the pair is compatible, scope-differentiated, or orthogonal. The calibration test asserts precision and recall against these labels.

cases.note: Same subject, opposite status, no scope qualifier.

a.title: The wiki recompile gate is enabled
a.content: The wiki recompile gate is enabled so the wiki stays in sync with the store.

b.title: The wiki recompile gate is disabled
b.content: The wiki recompile gate is disabled to avoid rewriting the wiki on every save.

cases.note: Same subject, opposite status, identical scope.

a.title: Connection pooling is enabled in production
a.content: Connection pooling is enabled in production to bound database connections.

b.title: Connection pooling is disabled in production
b.content: Connection pooling is disabled in production because the proxy owns pooling.

cases.note: Same database entity, different engine.

a.title: The primary database uses PostgreSQL
a.content: The primary database uses PostgreSQL for relational durability.

b.title: The primary database uses MySQL
b.content: The primary database uses MySQL for relational durability.

cases.note: Same service, different port binding.

a.title: The gateway binds to port 3000
a.content: The gateway binds to port 3000 for inbound traffic.

b.title: The gateway binds to port 8080
b.content: The gateway binds to port 8080 for inbound traffic.

cases.note: Same API surface, different protocol.

a.title: The public API uses REST
a.content: The public API uses REST for external consumers.

b.title: The public API uses GraphQL
b.content: The public API uses GraphQL for external consumers.

cases.note: Same runtime slot, different engine.

a.title: The CLI uses bun runtime
a.content: The CLI uses bun runtime for fast startup.

b.title: The CLI uses node runtime
b.content: The CLI uses node runtime for broad compatibility.

cases.note: Same imperative, opposite universal policy.

a.title: Always run the test suite
a.content: Always run the test suite before pushing to main.

b.title: Never run the test suite
b.content: Never run the test suite before pushing to main.

cases.note: Same subject, opposite permission.

a.title: The API allows cross-origin requests
a.content: The API allows cross-origin requests from any origin.

b.title: The API denies cross-origin requests
b.content: The API denies cross-origin requests from any origin.

cases.note: REGRESSION: scope-differentiated status claim (production vs localhost).

a.title: Postgres connection pooling is enabled in production
a.content: Postgres connection pooling is enabled in production to bound connections.

b.title: Postgres connection pooling is disabled on localhost
b.content: Postgres connection pooling is disabled on localhost to keep dev startup fast.

cases.note: REGRESSION: scope-differentiated status claim (default vs CI).

a.title: The nightly backup schedule is enabled by default
a.content: The nightly backup schedule is enabled by default for self-hosted installs.

b.title: The nightly backup schedule is disabled in CI
b.content: The nightly backup schedule is disabled in CI to keep builds hermetic.

cases.note: REGRESSION: same verb, different objects.

a.title: Audit log rotation is enabled for observations
a.content: Audit log rotation is enabled for observations to bound file growth.

b.title: Audit log rotation is disabled for the memory store
b.content: Audit log rotation is disabled for the memory store because SQLite handles it.

cases.note: REGRESSION: conditional scopes (model present vs absent).

a.title: The vector embedding pipeline is enabled when a model is present
a.content: The vector embedding pipeline is enabled when a model is present.

b.title: The vector embedding pipeline is disabled when no model is present
b.content: The vector embedding pipeline is disabled when no model is present.

cases.note: REGRESSION: tier-scoped tier-0 vs tier-2 statements.

a.title: Tiered context caching is enabled at tier 0
a.content: Tiered context caching is enabled at tier 0 for the manifest route.

b.title: Tiered context caching is disabled at tier 2
b.content: Tiered context caching is disabled at tier 2 to bound body tokens.

cases.note: REGRESSION: legacy vs fresh store scopes.

a.title: The migration backfill is enabled for legacy stores
a.content: The migration backfill is enabled for legacy stores.

b.title: The migration backfill is disabled for fresh stores
b.content: The migration backfill is disabled for fresh stores.

cases.note: REGRESSION: write vs read-only scopes.

a.title: The wiki recompile gate is enabled on save
a.content: The wiki recompile gate is enabled on save.

b.title: The wiki recompile gate is disabled in read only mode
b.content: The wiki recompile gate is disabled in read only mode.

cases.note: REGRESSION: before-compaction vs during-restore scopes.

a.title: The snapshot ring is enabled before compaction
a.content: The snapshot ring is enabled before compaction.

b.title: The snapshot ring is disabled during restore
b.content: The snapshot ring is disabled during restore.

cases.note: REGRESSION: same subject, different relations (audit rotation vs memory store).

a.title: The store enables the YAML mirror write path
a.content: The store enables the YAML mirror write path.

b.title: The store enables the SQLite outbox for durable writes
b.content: The store enables the SQLite outbox for durable writes.

cases.note: REGRESSION: a migration note names the old and the new engine; neither is the current state.

a.title: Migrated from MySQL to PostgreSQL
a.content: Migrated from MySQL to PostgreSQL during the v3 storage rewrite.

b.title: The primary database uses MySQL
b.content: The primary database uses MySQL for relational durability.

cases.note: REGRESSION: protocol conflict only when the API surface is the same.

a.title: The admin API uses REST
a.content: The admin API uses REST for internal tooling.

b.title: The public API uses GraphQL
b.content: The public API uses GraphQL for external consumers.

cases.note: REGRESSION: two services binding different ports are not in conflict.

a.title: The API binds to port 3000
a.content: The API binds to port 3000 for inbound traffic.

b.title: The worker binds to port 8080
b.content: The worker binds to port 8080 for the job queue.

cases.note: Same subject, same polarity — agreement, not contradiction.

a.title: The plugin registry is enabled
a.content: The plugin registry is enabled for every agent host.

b.title: The plugin registry is enabled
b.content: The plugin registry is enabled for every agent host.

cases.note: REGRESSION: a scoped claim refines a general one; the general claim does not state what happens in that scope, so the pair is not an established contradiction.

a.title: The cache is enabled
a.content: The cache is enabled for every read path.

b.title: The cache is disabled by default
b.content: The cache is disabled by default so reads always hit the source of truth.
